findings.title: Verify source manifest completeness before executing committed dossiers
findings.problem: The new mode verifies every listed raw fingerprint but never establishes that the list includes source/extraction input for each visible dossier chapter or all committed corpus extraction/prior-resolution inputs. A nonempty incomplete committed manifest passes; the offline fixture itself contains fixture:002:p001 with no data/fixture/002.json or data/people/extractions/fixture/002.json in either manifest or commit. loadPreparedDossiers still returns source-verified dossiers and actual main resumes a structural checkpoint/produces pending receipt.
findings.independentReproduction: Peer rerun adds explicit assertions that chapter002 source is absent from disk and manifest immediately before successful loadPreparedDossiers; the existing2-person dossier and real temporary Git commit otherwise unchanged. Zero API calls.
findings.impact: Pending receipt correctly prevents automatic acceptance/publication, but execution can still spend a worker on a packet whose referenced evidence and complete prior inputs were not verified at the specified commit. Ordinary local final aggregate validation formerly detects incomplete preparation; committed mode deliberately returns before that gate.
findings.requestedCorrection: Before worker execution, derive expected committed input inventory with bounded Git tree reads: committed extraction files plus corresponding chapter source files and committed resolution documents, and require manifest coverage/equality as appropriate; also explicitly require source+extraction entries for every visible dossier chapter. Reject omissions, with no source filesystem fallback or full corpus/resolver rebuild. Add real Git fixture negative coverage for a missing visible chapter input and omitted committed prior/extraction. Preserve pending-only host acceptance boundary.

positiveChecks.explicitOptions: Mode is explicit Cursor prepared execution only, with full40 commit, no prepare/self-test/Grok/out. rev-parse commit dereference must equal requested object; no mutable-ref fallback.
positiveChecks.boundedRawVerification: Metadata<=64 objects with blob/size checks; payload batches<=64 and32MiB, computed maxBuffer, exact byte hash and framing/trailing-byte checks. No local source fallback. Individual oversize fails before payload batching.
positiveChecks.preparedPackets: Manifest and full/worker packets still locally readable and exact Git-equal at the pinned ref; changed packet rejected.
positiveChecks.defaultPath: Default local source guard remains in separate unchanged behavior, dirty/missing local source rejects. Normal prepared aggregate still attempts full local corpus and propagates its failure.
positiveChecks.checkpointBoundary: All final approval booleans false; explicit --out rejected; committed path returns ignored checkpoint receipt before local aggregate write or cleanup. Existing canonical output collision guard retained.
positiveChecks.constraintsCaps: Normal validator/pruner/dossier builder/worker projection/part limits and budgets have no altered production hunks; no new source/identity/publication shortcut claimed.
